SHOW CAUSE NOTICE UNDER SECTION 74 OF THE CGST ACT 2017
Notice Ref: SCN/DL/2021/740 Dated 20-11-2021
GSTIN: 07BBBCC5678B1Z2 M/s Zenith Enterprises
FY: 2020-21

1. It is alleged that the taxpayer suppressed taxable turnover in monthly GSTR-3B returns with intent to evade payment of tax during FY 2020-21.
2. In view of the deliberate suppression, extended period of limitation under Section 74(1) is invoked proposing demand of tax amounting to Rs. 5,00,000/- along with penalty under Section 74.
